name: Holi Essentials Poojan & Celebration Kit
format: Holika Dahan and Holi celebration kit
description: Everything for Holika Dahan and Holi in one box: herbal gulal in 4 natural colours; roli, akshat, haldi, gehu and mishri; coloured incense sticks; kapoor and kachcha soot dhaga; samidha sticks for Holika Dahan; a panchgavya havan cup; rose water; thandai powder; kids-safe body crayons; and a Holi ritual guide booklet to follow step by step.
